text:
sasha: heads up — onboarding run for tessera-13b-q4f (quantized) failed in CI twice in a row, looks like k8s preemption + tokenizer oddness. logs below.

benedict: can you paste the failing log lines? also which eval job?

sasha: eval-runner/job-onnx-evals-197 ran on node g4-preempt. Runner exited with status 143 (SIGTERM) while streaming tokens to harness. harness then saw no final metric file and marked as FAIL. snippets: 
```
2026-03-19T14:22:11Z INFO model_runner: starting tessera-13b-q4f quant session
2026-03-19T14:23:02Z WARN k8s: pod preempted, SIGTERM received
2026-03-19T14:23:03Z INFO model_runner: flush partial outputs to stream
2026-03-19T14:23:03Z ERROR eval_harness: metrics.json not found, marking test FAILED
```

lia: hmm — I also saw the tokenizer mapping for tessera had been updated to preserve U+2028 as a sentinel in the hf tokenizer upgrade. That makes some chat templates generate an extra invisible token at the end so "stream finished" heuristics relying on trailing newline can miss EOS.

quant-qa: reproduced locally: when preemption happens mid-generation the runner writes a partial `stream.jsonl` where last line is truncated and not newline-terminated, our parser fails to pick it up as complete and we never compute metrics. CLI shows last record ends with half-utf8 sequence.

benedict: two things to fix ASAP: (1) make eval-runner robust to truncated final lines (tolerate no trailing newline and try to parse last partial json), (2) in CI set podPriorityClass for non-critical evals to avoid preemption flapping while we triage.

infra-sre: setting lower preemptible class on those runs is doable for a week. I'll add a hard limit to retries too.

ci-bot: triggered rerun: eval-runner/job-onnx-evals-198 queued (priority: low-preempt).

lia: quick patch suggestion for runner to handle truncated json: 
```
# pseudopatch for eval-runner/stream_reader.py
- for line in f:
-   parsed = json.loads(line)
+ buf = f.read()
+ if not buf.endswith('\n'):
+   # try to recover last line
+   try:
+     parsed = json.loads(buf)
+   except JSONDecodeError:
+     # attempt to salvage by adding closing braces/brackets used in our records
+     buf_fixed = buf + '"}'  # best-effort heuristics
+     parsed = json.loads(buf_fixed)
```

benedict: I think we should avoid heuristics that mutate content — better to use incremental JSON streaming (ijson) or try `json.loads` on the last newline-separated chunk, and if that fails, attempt to detect utf-8 boundary and decode the last valid slice. Add a robust test to the harness for truncated streams.

quant-qa: added unit test locally: `tests/test_stream_recovery.py` that simulates truncated utf-8 and truncated json lines — passes with the incremental decode approach. Will open PR in a few mins.

sasha: also note tokenizer quirk: tessera's hf tokenizer started emitting U+2028 as a separate token only when `preserve_formatting=True`. For eval configs we set `preserve_formatting=false` but a new default sneaked in upstream. Suggest adding explicit tokenizer_config in model config to pin `preserve_formatting: false` so CI is deterministic.

infra-sre: agree. I'll add a config override in the k8s job template so model onboarding jobs always pass `--tokenizer-config` from our pinned repo.

benedict: once PRs for runner and config go in, let's run a small batch (5 runs) on non-preemptible nodes, check `metrics.json` generation and diff with reference. If metric divergence > 1% for any eval, we pause rollout.

sasha: thanks all — flagged high priority. @quant-qa please drop PR link and test logs here when ready. :thumbsup:

quant-qa: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/eval-runner/pull/412 — includes tests and a fallback reader. attaching local run output: 
```
Ran 5 evals on tessera-13b-q4f (quant) — 0 failures, recovered 2 truncated streams, metrics computed.
```

benedict: LGTM from me on tests. infra, once you've applied the job config override I'll merge and trigger canary.

infra-sre: override applied to `ci-templates/eval-onboard.yaml` with `tokenizer_config: preserve_formatting=false` and `priorityClassName: low-preemptible` — canary queued.

sasha: merging notes: updated onboarding checklist to include tokenizer_config pinning and add stream-recovery test. leaving this thread open until canary completes.

ci-bot: canary run started: eval-runner/job-onnx-evals-204 (1977654685)

quant-qa: canary finished: all green, metrics stable. closing ticket. :tada:
